All eight root issues (not duplicated downstream)

1. BH-G-000110 — Major — unresolved admissible-domain membership

  • First origin: p6:thm:positive-dimensional-obstruction at Paper5B:493–515.
  • Finding: The free singular-value counterfamily T_lambda(1)=lambda u_S is algebraically distinct, but source-matched membership in the admissible action/readout quotient is not certified. The non-singleton conclusion is not refuted; a typed admissibility witness is required.
  • DAG record: DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5B-v1_4/GapRegistry.json contains typed origin, available evidence, qualified impacts and bypasses.

2. BH-G-000111 — Moderate — source type mismatch

  • First origin: p6:thm:conditional-finite-sufficiency at Paper5B:754–823.
  • Finding: The defined raw bridge contains H_comp, while the sufficient structural subtuple consumes H_norm as though it were the same component. The source needs an explicit equivalence or a consistent typed tuple; the dependent minimality claims inherit this root.
  • DAG record: DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5B-v1_4/GapRegistry.json contains typed origin, available evidence, qualified impacts and bypasses.

3. BH-G-000112 — Major — normalization identity inconsistent

  • First origin: p6:thm:finite-part-covariance at Paper5B:1929–1935.
  • Finding: The printed identity U=6/R_mom^2 conflates intrinsic K_p=6/R_mom^2 and cell scalarized U=(3/pi)K_p=18/(pi R_mom^2). Other terminal-scale formulas use the latter; the hierarchy arithmetic is unaffected when that correctly defined upstream factor is used.
  • DAG record: DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5B-v1_4/GapRegistry.json contains typed origin, available evidence, qualified impacts and bypasses.

4. BH-G-000113 — Major — physical role-source provenance unresolved

  • First origin: p6:thm:v591-owner-provenance-charged-grades at Paper5B:3826–3871.
  • Finding: Polar comparison grades and their mathematical exponents calculate correctly, but the proof does not construct the actual generated role-specific port and chiral frame selecting one comparison operation for each charged role. Algebraic comparison classes are not automatically physical source derivatives.
  • DAG record: DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5B-v1_4/GapRegistry.json contains typed origin, available evidence, qualified impacts and bypasses.

5. BH-G-000114 — Major — quantified scheme-domain failure

  • First origin: p6:thm:two-koide-intersections at Paper5B:4970–5121.
  • Finding: For a generic admissible positive REG_sigma member, two positive Koide intersections need not exist; an admissible log(alpha_sigma)=1 yields none. The two transverse REG_0 roots, Delta=0.125314767527812 and 0.377358234148416, remain independently reproduced and correct within that anchored member.
  • DAG record: DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5B-v1_4/GapRegistry.json contains typed origin, available evidence, qualified impacts and bypasses.

6. BH-G-000115 — Major — physical current polar-normalization link unresolved

  • First origin: p6:thm:v597-hopf-pcad-lepton-rays at Paper5B:5642–5719.
  • Finding: The whole 3x3 polar normalizer E_e(E_e^dagger E_e)^(-1/2) can mix raw plane rays. E_e=U [[1,0,0],[1,1,0],[0,0,1]] has normalized muon column (-g_e+2g_mu)/sqrt5, not g_mu. This is a general inference counterexample, not proven to be the actual generated source; a source-matched Gram/column certificate is missing.
  • DAG record: DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5B-v1_4/GapRegistry.json contains typed origin, available evidence, qualified impacts and bypasses.

7. BH-G-000116 — Moderate — selected current branch status contradiction

  • First origin: p6:thm:full-reconstruction at Paper5B:8661–8706 (and 8917–8920).
  • Finding: The current K56 harmonic branch at 7415–7422 declares the old D4/C3 and positive radical realization historical and no replacement physical closure, yet the integrated summary and later table call the radical operator the current selected physical neutral operator. Historical radical mathematics survives; the branch status claims require reconciliation.
  • DAG record: DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5B-v1_4/GapRegistry.json contains typed origin, available evidence, qualified impacts and bypasses.

8. BH-G-000117 — Minor — RG formula missing analytic domain guard

  • First origin: p6:thm:exact-qrg-transport at Paper5B:7948–7991.
  • Finding: Dividing the quark mass RGE by beta_S^(nf)(alpha_s) requires beta nonzero along the coupling path or a justified crossing. At a beta(a)=0, gamma_m(a)!=0 fixed point, mass evolves with mu while the displayed coupling-variable integral is undefined. This does not assert the actual physical QCD path crosses such a zero.
  • DAG record: DAG/AuditLayer/Paper5B-v1_4/GapRegistry.json contains typed origin, available evidence, qualified impacts and bypasses.

Scope-preserving verified controls

  • Structural and finite source controls: six projector ranks 18+6+9+9+3+3=48, primitive A2 trace identities, five-core 25-incidence rank 17 and Gram eigenvalues, polar-normalization algebra, generic Majorana/Dirac flavor quotient dimensions, rational Jacobian witnesses.
  • Charged shell: two positive, transverse Koide intersections and reported mass outputs only for the displayed REG_0 member; a generic positive scheme need not have two.
  • Negative-Hopf rays: geometric orthonormal frame and zeta_e=sqrt3/2 orientation; identification of the post-polar physical current is a separate unresolved bridge.
  • Current neutral harmonic branch: candidate eigenvalue packet (1/163,5,163), conditional ratio R=407/13284 and the E56 energy insertion; physical K56 source constructor, rest-pole map and oscillation phases are not derived by this geometric calculation.
  • Final A5/pair sector: independent direct permutation tests give B5 rank 17, unsigned pair rank 42, signed pair rank 34, 25-dimensional class projector, published response spectra, 8 singular commutator values 1/12, fusion spectrum, Petersen/Gamma identity, A4-conjugacy orbit count. No physical hadron mass inferred.
  • Current-source pole, width, quark QRG and heavy scale remain separate downstream interfaces. Historical D4 inverse/direct/Gram model and radical comparison are not promoted to the current physical harmonic branch.

Assumption, impact and provenance policy

All new conditions are source-derived domain predicates, not new constitutional axioms. Condition BH-VB-A-0001 guards beta-nonzero/crossing for the exact RGE change of variable. Current harmonic physical-origin and pole/propagation obligations are marked conditional and traced only through actually imported or reviewed source edges. Earlier Paper V-A charged-source conditionality remains an upstream import, not a fresh independent V-B physics axiom.

Source-matched reviewed edges enter the combined material index only when marked active, reviewed, and of a proof-use kind. Citation-only and candidate links remain quarantined. Impacts outside the verified routes are marked possible, not automatically proven. No supplied paper or earlier audit status was changed.
